subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: What Gateway startup contract should OpenClaw own when a configured channel plugin cannot register before `listChannelPlugins()` sees it?
rationale: The narrow source gap is clear, but the issue mixes warn-and-continue auditing, fail-fast compatibility checks, hot reload, missing-module recovery, and performance caching; those choices can change upgrade and operator behavior.

options.title: Audit Configured Channels First
options.body: Keep plugin diagnostics as-is, add a Gateway startup audit that reports configured-but-unregistered channels with reason/source, and track hot reload/performance separately.

options.title: Fail Fast On Incompatible Channels
options.body: Make configured channel/plugin incompatibility block startup with an ERROR, accepting stronger operator visibility at the cost of possible upgrade breakage.

options.title: Split And Close After Narrow Trackers
options.body: Move bundled missing-module handling to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/86039 and require separate issues for hot reload and performance before changing Gateway startup behavior.

recommendation.title: Audit Configured Channels First
recommendation.body: Keep plugin diagnostics as-is, add a Gateway startup audit that reports configured-but-unregistered channels with reason/source, and track hot reload/performance separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest current-history match for plugin loader validation, bundled channel helper cleanup, and the related setup-discovery review direction.
